name: Lavaux vineyard terraces
why: Through stone-walled vineyard terraces stepping down to Lake Geneva, a World Heritage landscape, between the wine villages of Lutry and St-Saphorin.
book: Free. Train back along the lake.
water: Wine cellars and cafes in the villages.

points.name: Lutry
points.note: A lakeside wine village east of Lausanne.

points.name: Chexbres
points.note: A village high on the terraces with the lake and the Alps.

points.name: St-Saphorin
points.note: A small medieval wine village by the lake.
